---
name: "Priority"
description: "Use when setting Priority for an Azure DevOps work item. Requires a default value with defined escalation and de-escalation rules."
---

# Priority Format

Default Priority to **2**.

- Increase to **1** when the work blocks other work, or when its Risk value is High.
- Decrease to **3** when the work does not affect production systems or users and is not time-sensitive.

Otherwise, keep Priority at the default of 2. State the reason when Priority is set to 1 or 3.
